== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Death Star Tractor Beam (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. Compared with [[Death Star Tractor Beam (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>b8517029a1398499c9d56486b789e9146bc43cd6</code>.
